Name: JP's I Cut Down A Tree And It Flew Away
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]I Cut Down A Tree And It Flew Away[/center][/u][/color][/size][/b]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]I swear that when I cut down that tree, it walked away! “Sure, just like when you said you cut down another tree and it flew away, huh?” [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4]This is a pointless mod. I had an idea and decided to make it. It changes the animation of trees when they are cut down to ones that might be fun to watch. It doesn't change anything else at all. Trees can also be of other sizes, but this doesn't change the resources they provide.
Everything is configurable through GMCM. If you don't like something, you can remove it. [/size]


[size=5][b][i][color=#00ff00]And that's it, short but sweet. I hope it makes you smile or brightens up your day a little! Here are some examples. There are currently [/color][color=#ffff00]22 different animations[/color][color=#00ff00] that occur randomly. [/color]
[/i][/b][/size]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W3QwbCRr/Trees1.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ydwyYtqZ/Trees2.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/26P78MpL/Trees3.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/k4kvXzrt/Trees4.gif[/img]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
